notes: Pages 2-4 carry the header "FDP Form 10b - Bid Results on Goods and Services" struck through (pages 2-3) but are titled CIVIL WORKS and continue the civil works numbering (rows 7-31); all 31 rows are in one table.
Page 3 (rows 15-21) is headed "3rd Quarter, CY 2022" while the other pages say "4th Quarter, CY 2022"; its rows were bid on 10-Nov-22, so the page header appears to be a typo. Period kept as Q4 2022.
A stray figure "344,693.52" (the bid amount of row 10) is printed above the table on page 2; ignored.
Row 14 (22-45): bid amount 14,153,379.85 is far below the ABC 17,153,872.00; transcribed as printed.

The "Name and Address Of Bidder" column was split into bidderContact (person) and bidderAddress. Row 24 prints only an address. Locations are copied as printed, including "Pajo, LL" (row 31) and "LLc" variants.

bidderNormalized: a canonical spelling added by the transcriber so the same company ranks as one bidder across documents (case, punctuation and obvious misspellings unified, e.g. variants confirmed by the bidder name repeated in the address column or by an identical contact person/address). The printed name is kept unchanged in bidder.
